# dsh-composer-prediction
ChatGPT-style **composer predictions** for DeepSeek Harness.

After each assistant turn, the plugin asks a cheap chat model for the message you
are most likely to

send next and paints it as **ghost text in the empty
composer**. Press **Tab** to insert it into th

e draft (nothing is sent), **Esc**
to dismiss it, or just start typing to discard it. Turn the whole

thing off in
**Settings → Predictions**, a dedicated Settings section this plugin
contributes (`set
tings.section`), because the shipped Plugins page is read-only.
## Behaviour
| Event | Result |
| Assistant turn ends (`running: true → false`) | A prediction is requested after the configured del

ay |
| Composer is not empty, or you are already typing | Nothing is requested or shown |
| An IME c
omposition is active (`data-composer-composing`) | No new prediction is requested and the offer is h

idden for the turn, until the composition ends |
| **Tab** while a prediction is visible | The whole

suggestion is inserted into the draft; nothing is sent |
| **Esc** while a prediction is visible |

The offer is withdrawn and not repeated for that turn |
| You open a session that already has an ass

istant answer | One prediction is made for its latest turn, then deduped per session + turn |
| You
switch to another session and back | The cached offer is restored immediately; no new request is mad

e (up to 40 sessions are remembered) |
| A switched-to session needs a new prediction | It waits for
the chat store to swap (node list change, 400 ms cap) so the request can never carry the previous s

ession's transcript |
| You type or attach a file | The offer is hidden; clearing the draft brings i

t back for the same turn |
| You switch the feature off and back on | Forgets the session's offer an

d "already asked" marker, then predicts again immediately |
| You accept, dismiss, start a new turn,

or disable the feature | The offer is discarded and any in-flight request is cancelled |
| A respon
se arrives late or for an older turn | Dropped — it can never replace or resurrect a newer offer |

## Configuration

Everything lives in `$DSH_HOME/composer-predict.json` and in the Settings page.
The document is writ

ten by the plugin's host half (merge + atomic rename); it is
not a `settings.yaml` namespace because

the 0.2.x `ctx.settings` service is a form
layer over loader entries and no longer hands a plugin a
live namespace scope.
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch (also the Settings toggle) |
| `provider` | `""` | Empty = the

deployment default route (`ctx.agentDefaultModel`) |
| `model` | `""` | Empty = the deployment defau

lt model |
| `maxTokens` | `64` | Output cap for the prediction |
| `temperature` | `0.8` | Sampling

temperature (direct-HTTP transport only) |
| `delayMs` | `0` | Quiet period after a turn before pre

dicting |
| `maxSuggestionChars` | `200` | Hard cap on an offered suggestion |
| `contextMessages` |

`10` | Trailing messages fed to the predictor |
| `maxContextChars` | `6000` | Transcript character

budget |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | Fallback only: used when no harness LLM service

is composed |
| `apiKey` | `""` | Fallback only: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, then `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.y

mposed |
| `apiKey` | `""` | Fallback only: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, then `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` |
### Model and reasoning

By default the plugin calls **the harness's own LLM service** (`ctx.llm`), not a
private endpoint. T

the plugin calls **the harness's own LLM service** (`ctx.llm`), not a
private endpoint. That means:

- it uses the **same provider route and credentials as your sessions** — with a
subscription route (

`deepseek-account`, Kimi, …) you need no API key at all;
- the model is your **deployment default**

(`ctx.agentDefaultModel`, e.g.
`deepseek-flash`) unless you override `provider`/`model` in Settings;

- **reasoning is pinned to the model's cheapest advertised effort**
(`model.reasoning.efforts[0]`).

A next-message guess should not spend a
thinking budget; if the model advertises no efforts, the pr

ovider default is
left alone. Output is capped at `maxTokens` (64 by default).

## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The overlay measures the real `[data-composer-input]` element and clones its
font metrics, so paddin

g, wrapping and height follow the composer instead of
guessing at CSS. The native placeholder is hid

den (and restored) only while the
ghost is visible.

Bundles are built without a toolchain: `scripts/build-client.mjs` concatenates
the shared helpers an

d the component body into the `window.__ModuleLoader__`
factory the host serves — no bundler, no dep
endencies, no network.
## Limitations

- The prediction triggers on the idle transition; if you are already typing when
the turn ends, no o

ffer is made (deliberately: it should never fight the user).
- The ghost is positioned over the firs

t line of an empty composer; a composer
pre-filled with attachments does not show an offer.
- `predi

ctNow` needs a finished turn to have transcript context.
- Verified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; the cl

ient bundle targets the
`conversation.input.overlay` slot and the `data-composer-input` contentedita

ble
introduced in `0.1.5`.
